resources.string: API keys
Your own keys for posters, voice search and search by description
Services
About these keys
Mayo TV works without any of these keys. Each one switches on one extra that uses an outside service, on your own account with that service.
Your keys stay on this TV. A backup carries the TMDB key only when you protect it with a password; the other two keys are never in a backup.

Posters, plot and cast for films and series
Voice search that gets names right
Search by description
Posters, backdrops, plot and cast for films and series, the film and series catalogs, and where a title is streaming. Without a key you see what your playlist provides.
Voice search writes down exactly what you say, names included. Without a key the TV\'s own speech recognition is used, if it has one.

Search by description: type or say what you feel like, such as “a creepy film with a cabin in the woods”, and Mayo TV finds fitting films, series and programmes. It also helps voice search pick the channel or title you meant.
Free at themoviedb.org: create an account, then go to Settings › API. Copy the “API Key” (32 characters), not the long read access token.
At elevenlabs.io, under API keys. A key limited to speech to text is enough. Each voice search uses some of your ElevenLabs credits.
At typesafe.ai: sign in and create an API key. Each search by description uses some of your TypeSafe credits.
